turns.text: Good morning, Northgate Services, how can I help?
I'm Ethos, calling on behalf of Gordon Ashworth. He has an existing appointment that needs to be cancelled.
I'm sorry to hear that, Ethos. Can you please tell me the date and time of his current appointment so we can arrange for a cancellation?
His number is 0161 496 0244. He was originally booked in for Tuesday morning.
I've checked our diary, but it looks like Tuesday morning is fully booked. What alternative day would you like to book Gordon for?
He is free on either Wednesday morning.
Wednesday morning has availability at 9:30am and 11:00am. Would either of those time slots work for you, or would you prefer an earlier appointment?
He prefers something closer to noon, actually - around 11am.
I think I can accommodate that. Let me just check again... (pause) Yes, I've got a booking available at 11:00am on Wednesday for Gordon Ashworth. Shall I confirm that for you?
That sounds good, thank you.
Just to confirm, the booking is for Gordon Ashworth at 11:00am on Wednesday, 0161 496 0224 - is that correct?
Yes, that's right. Thank you for reading it back accurately.
Good morning, Northgate Services, how can I help?
I'm Ethos calling on behalf of Meera Sundaram. She would like to book a new appointment for a kitchen fitting.
What day was she thinking of coming in for the fitting? (Waiting patiently)
She is available any weekday afternoon after two o'clock.
I've got you down for Wednesday at 2:30pm, that's taken. How about Tuesday at 3pm then, or would Monday at 4pm work better?
Actually, she prefers something closer to her original schedule - let's go with Thursday at 2pm instead.
I've got Thursday at 2pm for you, I just need the client's contact number so I can confirm and send you a booking confirmation. Can you please give me Meera Sundaram's phone number?

I've taken note of that. Just to confirm, so it's Meera Sundaram with a kitchen fitting on Thursday at 2pm, with your contact number and ours for booking purposes. Does she have an account number with us? (Waiting for response)
That information isn't required for this particular booking, thank you.
I've got the appointment booked then. Here's a quick rundown of the booking: Meera Sundaram has a kitchen fitting on Thursday at 2pm, thanks!
Just to make sure, that means we're booking a new appointment for Thursday at 2pm? And do you still have the same details - including the client's number if possible?
